description: Change the role of an existing binding. Requires a service JWT (com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth) and the admin role. Demoting the last admin is rejected.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller has no role or the role does not allow managing role bindings.

errors.name: RoleNotFound
errors.description: The subject holds no role binding.

errors.name: LastAdmin
errors.description: The change would leave no admin in the workspace.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The subject DID or role value is not acceptable.
